description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to Buzz comments in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, allowing the setting and getting of a share ID and specifying allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering options when searching for Buzz comments, including share ID and sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams and sets the default sort field to 'comment.createdAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the share ID associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID for the search filter.
